$comment: The consumer side of the published-artifact contract (T177). A consuming module reads only the derived artifact (ssot/derived/btnyc_graph.json today), and runs artifact_compat.check() against this file before it reads an index. interface_version moves only when a consumer would break: a major bump for a removed or reshaped index or a changed key meaning, a minor bump for an added index. source_schema_versions and derivation_versions list what the consumers accept; they differ from interface_version on purpose (P-SYSTEM-VERSIONS).

matching.applies_to: every customer word the artifact carries to be looked for in free text: the keys of alias_index and the synonyms of a smart tag
matching.rule: A term matches a text when it occurs there as a whole word or a whole phrase. It never matches inside another word.
matching.inflections: The canonical matcher also accepts 's, s, es, ed and ing after the term, and, for a term ending in e, ed and ing after the e is dropped (replace -> replacing). It does not produce doubled-consonant forms (drip -> dripping, clog -> clogged); those are covered by listing the word.
matching.why_it_is_stated: The vocabulary keeps terms that are fragments of other words (cement in replacement, desk in desktop, screen in flatscreen, range in strange); the matching rule, not the vocabulary, keeps them from firing. A consumer that matches by substring reproduces DEFECT-WITHIN-WORD-MATCH (T166).
